note: Sound talents whose printed text explicitly runs through silent vibration, contact resonance, soul-sound, or a special feature, and the printed words that say so. A silence area that prints its own-Sound clause (Forbidden Silence Field: "You may use Sound talents inside the Field only if they explicitly function through silent vibration, contact resonance, soul-sound, or a special feature") admits these talents and no other. record id -> {name, channel, why}; channel must be one of the area's own printed channels. Owner-editable, like combat/rules/speech.json. A talent is listed only when its own text names the channel: Muffle Footfall and Silent Step Between Notes are silent but name none, so the Field stops them.

TAL_SOUND_NAME_STRIKING_TONE.name: Name-Striking Tone
TAL_SOUND_NAME_STRIKING_TONE.why: Heading: "Voice, Soul-Sound"; it may "Speak, ring, or resonate a creature's name, title, cultivation epithet, true voice-pattern, or battle-call".

TAL_SOUND_READ_THE_VIBRATION.name: Read the Vibration
TAL_SOUND_READ_THE_VIBRATION.why: "Listen to vibration in air, ground, water, walls, objects, weapons, or living bodies."

TAL_SOUND_TREMOR_LISTENING.name: Tremor Listening
TAL_SOUND_TREMOR_LISTENING.why: "you may use Read the Vibration through that surface", range "along the connected surface".

TAL_SOUND_STONE_BELL_PROPAGATION.name: Stone-Bell Propagation
TAL_SOUND_STONE_BELL_PROPAGATION.why: "a target touching the same continuous surface, structure, bridge, wall, floor, pillar, chain, or bell network as you".

TAL_SOUND_BODY_RESONANCE_STRIKE.name: Body Resonance Strike
TAL_SOUND_BODY_RESONANCE_STRIKE.why: "release a close vibration through the target".

TAL_SOUND_BELL_SHELL_GUARD.name: Bell-Shell Guard
TAL_SOUND_BELL_SHELL_GUARD.why: Its printed trigger is "sound, voice, thunder, or vibration" and its cost names an "approved bell, gong, shield-chime, or body-resonance variant".

TAL_SOUND_MOUNTAIN_CRACKING_BELL.name: Mountain-Cracking Bell
TAL_SOUND_MOUNTAIN_CRACKING_BELL.why: "Strike a bell-note, shout, drumbeat, or silent vibration that shakes great structures."

TAL_SOUND_SOUND_SOVEREIGN_INCARNATION.name: Sound-Sovereign Incarnation
TAL_SOUND_SOUND_SOVEREIGN_INCARNATION.why: "you may speak or transmit through your own Sound talents even inside ordinary Silence", and its Blindsight is "based on vibration and soul-sound".
